documents.title: Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI LODR
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Vadilal Industries reported financial performance for FY19 and Q1FY20, noting a 3% growth in reported revenues for FY19 and double-digit growth at the start of FY20. Management highlighted international revenue expansion, gross margin improvements driven by volume growth and benign raw material prices, and stable debt levels. The company outlined ongoing capital expenditure plans of Rs. 30-35 crore for the year and continued focus on distribution and geographic expansion. Vadilal Industries Limited reported strong revenue and margin growth for the third quarter and nine months of FY19, driven by robust domestic volumes and rapid international expansion, particularly in the US.

guidance.claim: The company expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on regular capital expenditure during the year.
guidance.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

guidance.claim: Management maintains a positive business outlook for consumption and international growth.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we maintain our positive business outlook – better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector and continued traction in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: International revenues continued to deliver expansion, crossing the $20 million milestone backed by 54% revenue growth during FY19.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues continued to deliver encouraging expansion to cross the $ 20 million milestone, on the back of 54% revenue growth during FY19.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended winter and impacted ice cream consumption.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The company started FY20 with double-digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in the international business.
demand_outlook.quote: We have started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business growth is now reverting to historical trends.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

demand_outlook.claim: Management pointed out that latent demand for quality Indian products is driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales.
demand_outlook.quote: Latent demand for quality Indian products driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales

demand_outlook.claim: International business has witnessed robust demand as distribution was expanded.
demand_outlook.quote: International business has witnessed robust demand as VIL expanded distribution and is selling products focused on Indian diaspora in the US and other geographies

capex_expansion.claim: Estimated capex for FY20 is approximately Rs. 30 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 20 at ~ Rs. 30 crore

capex_expansion.claim: The company stated that no major capital expenditure is anticipated on capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote: No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated the estimated capex for FY 19 at approximately Rs. 35 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year due to volume growth, benign raw material prices, and larger international contribution.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year on the back of volume growth, benign raw material prices and larger contribution from international operations, where realizations are significantly higher.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations.
margins_costs.quote: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations that now have a base of over 50 employees.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.

margins_costs.claim: The company has visibility of stable costs covered till Q2 based on raw material purchases and inventory position.
margins_costs.quote: Based on our raw material purchase and inventory position, we have visibility of stable costs covered till Q2.

margins_costs.claim: As milk prices are at higher levels now, the company will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.
margins_costs.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: On a nine-month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.
margins_costs.quote: On nine month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over 1,000 bps.
margins_costs.quote: gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices continue to be subdued for the next season, which should benefit margins.
margins_costs.quote: We have been engaging with raw material suppliers for the next season and prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.

orders_capacity.claim: Production capacity was expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

orders_capacity.claim: Vadilal products currently reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, Vadilal products reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states and we remain committed to expand the network judiciously.

risks_headwinds.claim: Domestic business was impacted by exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that domestic business growth was temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore of regular capital expenditure during the year.
management_commitments.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

management_commitments.claim: The company will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year as milk prices are at higher levels.
management_commitments.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
